title: Obsidian Radar weekly snapshot
description: data/snapshots/YYYY-Www.json.gz (gzip of this JSON). Downloads are cumulative totals; weekly growth is computed by comparing snapshots, never stored.

statsUpdated.description: Newest per-plugin 'updated' time seen in community-plugin-stats.json.

plugins.description: Number of plugins in community-plugins.json at capture time; equals the number of keys in data.

refresh.description: State of the rolling GitHub metadata refresh. state=rolling means some plugins still carry older (or no) metadata and are refreshed first on the next run.

withMeta.description: Plugins that carry GitHub metadata (fresh or carried over).

pending.description: Plugins not refreshed in this run (they carry older metadata, or none).

limited.description: True when the run stopped early (rate limit, budget or missing token).

rel.description: Date of the latest release as reported by community-plugin-stats.json ('updated').

arch.description: Present (1) when the repository is archived.

iss.description: Open issues (GraphQL: issues only; REST bootstrap: includes pull requests).

fr.description: Open issues whose label looks like a feature request (GraphQL only).

gone.description: Present (1) when GitHub reports the repository as not found.

chk.description: Day the GitHub metadata was last checked.

src.description: Transport of the last check: g = GraphQL, r = REST.
